Thanks for the update, Samara — totally understand.

Quick troubleshooting checklist for the 401 you hit (common causes):
1) Ensure the temp key from trial-temp-key.txt is copied exactly (no leading/trailing spaces).
2) Confirm the request has header Authorization: Bearer <trial-key>. Example curl: 

   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED-TRIAL-KEY-abc123" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'

3) If your service uses an egress proxy, ensure TLS interception is not replacing certs.

If the 401 persists I can repro from our side given the request headers and timestamp. Otherwise I’m available:
- Thu Jul 22, 9:30–10:00 PT (I can do a focused 30m pairing session)
- Thu Jul 22, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Fri Jul 23, 08:30–09:00 PT (backup)

Which slot works for your team? I’ll put a calendar invite once you confirm.

Also cc’ing Marissa — she’ll join if we need to step through SDK usage or sample code changes.

Best,
Vivek
